evidence: Inspected complete generated body decompiled/main/main_0109.c:13970-14692. Dispatches through a 16-bit relative jump table for selector-like inputs and makes context, provider, and predicate helper calls; return paths are boolean. Indexed callers at main_0109.c:8061,12536,41819 and the existing format_bullpen_attribute_label caller at main_0109.c:41155 pass different contexts/IDs. No exact output semantics supported.

Inspected complete body decompiled/main/main_0054.c:49329-50042. The function initializes an output on x1, loops over context status IDs (0x0d,0x13) and mode/status gates, calls pointer/path helpers and writes selected record output; callers include populate_record_output_from_attributes at main_0055.c:30297 and f_700071e4b0 at main_0054.c:50103. Exact record semantics unresolved.

Inspected complete body decompiled/main/main_0119.c:50903-51310. Initializes a 32-bit scratch record at input+0x50ec, obtains context status selector 4, resolves nested provider and player attribute 0x0c, checks flags and thresholds, and dispatches validation/update helpers; callers main_0119.c:40979 and :44211 plus tail-forwarder :46768. Exact purpose/output unresolved.

Inspected complete body decompiled/main/main_0119.c:10407-10535. With input flag at +0x42a, checks status selector 0x13 for values 6 or 7, resolves nested provider/context and player attribute ID 0x28, then returns a bucket 0..9 or -2 by thresholds; called by populate_player_attribute_values at main_0116.c:32975 and :33803, plus five other indexed callers. Exact meaning of the bucket is unresolved.

Inspected complete body decompiled/main/main_0056.c:6643-6782. Validates two attribute records from x1/x2 and category slots, checks context status selector 0x13 and candidate-value availability, invokes process_attribute_record_candidate_values at :6726; callers include f_7000436d28, f_7000437690 and f_70007130e8. Broader operation ambiguous, so keep generated name.

Inspected complete body decompiled/main/main_0158.c:10145-10205. Reads state selector at flight+0x184, resolves selected record via f_7001661328 (or fallback flight+0x2e8), then loops while sample count at +0x188 is nonzero, builds two sample records from signed offsets +0x110/+0x114 and appends via pitch_flight_append_sample_record; if append fails, calls pitch_flight_integrate_selected_state. Indexed caller process_canned_deflection_flight_segment at main_0001.c:8715 and six flight-body callers confirm subsystem.
